traceability.notes: All specified requirements for 006.0-DEV-FILE-VALIDATION are implemented and covered by tests. The valid-story-reference ESLint rule parses @story annotations, resolves paths relative to context.cwd/process.cwd with configurable storyDirectories, enforces the .story.md extension by default, and can relax that via requireStoryExtension. Security checks prevent disallowed absolute paths and path traversal and enforce that any resolved path remains inside the project boundary, even when storyDirectories are misconfigured. Filesystem interactions are cached and error-tolerant, distinguishing between missing files and filesystem errors and surfacing them via clear, specific diagnostics (fileMissing, invalidExtension, invalidPath, fileAccessError). User-facing documentation describes the rule’s behavior and configuration consistently with the story. The dedicated test suite exercises file existence, extension enforcement, path resolution, configuration options, project-boundary behavior, and error-handling scenarios, and all tests currently pass. Therefore this story is fully implemented and passes its acceptance criteria.
